SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) AS ratio
FROM customers

SELECT ym.CustomerID
FROM yearmonth ym
JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212'
AND c.Segment = 'LAM'
ORDER BY ym.Consumption ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(monthly_consumption) AS average_monthly_consumption
FROM (
    SELECT ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) / 12 AS monthly_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Segment = 'SME' 
    AND ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID
) AS customer_monthly_avg

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'CZK' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_difference
FROM yearmonth ym
JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212'

SELECT SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) AS year
FROM yearmonth y
JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
GROUP BY SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4)
ORDER BY SUM(y.Consumption) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    SUBSTR(y.Date, 5, 2) AS month
FROM yearmonth y
JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'SME' 
    AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY SUM(y.Consumption) DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH segment_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Segment,
        AVG(ym.Consumption) AS avg_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE ym.Date LIKE '2013%'
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
segment_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_consumption END) AS sme_avg,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_consumption END) AS lam_avg,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_consumption END) AS kam_avg
    FROM segment_consumption
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT sme_avg FROM segment_averages) - (SELECT lam_avg FROM segment_averages) AS sme_lam_diff,
    (SELECT lam_avg FROM segment_averages) - (SELECT kam_avg FROM segment_averages) AS lam_kam_diff,
    (SELECT kam_avg FROM segment_averages) - (SELECT sme_avg FROM segment_averages) AS kam_sme_diff

WITH consumption_by_segment AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Segment,
        SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) as Year,
        SUM(ym.Consumption) as TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' 
        AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
        AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4)
),
consumption_pivot AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Year = '2012' THEN TotalConsumption END) as Consumption2012,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Year = '2013' THEN TotalConsumption END) as Consumption2013
    FROM consumption_by_segment
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT 
    Segment,
    CASE 
        WHEN Consumption2012 IS NOT NULL AND Consumption2012 > 0 
        THEN ((Consumption2013 - Consumption2012) / Consumption2012) * 100
        ELSE NULL 
    END as PercentageIncrease
FROM consumption_pivot
WHERE Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
ORDER BY Segment

SELECT SUM("Consumption") 
FROM "yearmonth" 
WHERE "CustomerID" = 6 
AND "Date" >= '201308' 
AND "Date" <= '201311'

SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gasstations WHERE Country = 'CZE' AND Segment = 'Value for money') -
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gasstations WHERE Country = 'SVK' AND Segment = 'Value for money') AS discount_difference

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM customers c
WHERE c.Segment = 'SME'

WITH lam_customers AS (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM customers
    WHERE Segment = 'LAM'
),
lam_consumers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ym.CustomerID
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN lam_customers lc ON ym.CustomerID = lc.CustomerID
    WHERE ym.Consumption > 46.73
)
SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT lc.CustomerID) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM lam_customers lc
LEFT JOIN lam_consumers lc2 ON lc.CustomerID = lc2.CustomerID

SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN Consumption > 528.3 THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM yearmonth
WHERE Date = '201202'

SELECT MAX(Consumption) AS highest_monthly_consumption
FROM yearmonth
WHERE SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4) = '2012'

SELECT DISTINCT p.Description
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
WHERE t.Date LIKE '2012-08-%'

SELECT DISTINCT gs.Country
FROM gasstations gs
JOIN transactions_1k t ON gs.GasStationID = t.GasStationID
WHERE t.Date LIKE '2012-08-%'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ym.CustomerID) 
FROM yearmonth ym
JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' 
AND ym.Consumption > 1000

SELECT DISTINCT p.Description
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
WHERE g.Country = 'CZE'

SELECT DISTINCT t."Time"
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t."GasStationID" = g."GasStationID"
WHERE g."ChainID" = 11
ORDER BY t."Time"

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE g.Country = 'CZE' 
AND t.Date > '2012-01-01'

SELECT DISTINCT c.Currency
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-24' 
AND t.Time = '16:25:00'

SELECT DISTINCT c.Segment
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN customers c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-23' AND t.Time = '21:20:00'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN gasstations g ON t.GasStationID = g.GasStationID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-26' 
AND t.Time BETWEEN '08:00:00' AND '09:00:00'
AND g.Country = 'CZE'

SELECT c.Segment
FROM customers c
JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-24' AND t.Price = 548.4

WITH customers_on_date AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k t
    WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25'
),
total_customers AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count
    FROM customers_on_date
),
eur_customers AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) as eur_count
    FROM customers_on_date c
    JOIN customers cust ON c.CustomerID = cust.CustomerID
    WHERE cust.Currency = 'EUR'
)
SELECT 
    CAST(e.eur_count AS FLOAT) * 100 / CAST(t.total_count AS FLOAT) AS percentage
FROM eur_customers e, total_customers t

SELECT 
    (y2012.Consumption - y2013.Consumption) / y2012.Consumption AS consumption_decrease_rate
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN yearmonth y2012 ON t.CustomerID = y2012.CustomerID AND y2012.Date LIKE '2012%'
JOIN yearmonth y2013 ON t.CustomerID = y2013.CustomerID AND y2013.Date LIKE '2013%'
WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25' AND t.Price = 634.8
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN g.Segment = 'Premium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS premium_percentage
FROM gasstations g
WHERE g.Country = 'SVK'

SELECT 
    SUM(t.Amount) AS total_amount,
    SUM(CASE WHEN t.Date LIKE '2012-08%' THEN t.Amount ELSE 0 END) AS august_2012_amount
FROM transactions_1k t
WHERE t.CustomerID = 38508

WITH customer_spending AS (
    SELECT 
        t."CustomerID",
        SUM(t."Price") as total_spent,
        SUM(t."Price") / SUM(t."Amount") as avg_price_per_item
    FROM transactions_1k t
    GROUP BY t."CustomerID"
),
top_customer AS (
    SELECT "CustomerID", total_spent, avg_price_per_item
    FROM customer_spending
    ORDER BY total_spent DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    tc."CustomerID",
    tc.avg_price_per_item,
    c."Currency"
FROM top_customer tc
JOIN customers c ON tc."CustomerID" = c."CustomerID"

SELECT ym.CustomerID, ym.Consumption
FROM yearmonth ym
JOIN transactions_1k t ON ym.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
WHERE ym.Date = '201208'
AND t.ProductID = 5
AND (t.Price / t.Amount) > 29.00

SELECT m.major_name
FROM member mem
JOIN major m ON mem.link_to_major = m.major_id
WHERE mem.first_name = 'Angela' AND mem.last_name = 'Sanders'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM attendance a
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer'
AND m.t_shirt_size = 'Medium'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM (
    SELECT e.event_id
    FROM event e
    JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
    WHERE e.type = 'Meeting'
    GROUP BY e.event_id
    HAVING COUNT(a.link_to_member) > 10
) AS meeting_events

SELECT DISTINCT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
WHERE e.event_id IN (
    SELECT link_to_event
    FROM attendance
    GROUP BY link_to_event
    HAVING COUNT(link_to_member) > 20
)
AND e.event_id NOT IN (
    SELECT link_to_event
    FROM budget b
    JOIN expense exp ON b.budget_id = exp.link_to_budget
    WHERE b.category = 'Fundraising'
)

SELECT SUM(i.amount) AS total_funds
FROM income i
JOIN member m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE m.position = 'Vice President'

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE z.state = 'Illinois' OR z.short_state = 'IL'

SELECT e.approved
FROM expense e
JOIN attendance a ON e.link_to_member = a.link_to_member
JOIN event ev ON a.link_to_event = ev.event_id
WHERE ev.event_name = 'October Meeting' 
AND ev.event_date = '2019-10-08T00:00:00'
AND e.expense_date = '2019-10-08'

SELECT AVG(e.cost) as average_spend
FROM expense e
JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE m.first_name = 'Elijah' 
AND m.last_name = 'Allen'
AND (strftime('%m', e.expense_date) = '09' OR strftime('%m', e.expense_date) = '10')

SELECT 
    (SELECT SUM(b.spent) 
     FROM budget b 
     JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id 
     WHERE substr(e.event_date, 1, 4) = '2019') -
    (SELECT SUM(b.spent) 
     FROM budget b 
     JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id 
     WHERE substr(e.event_date, 1, 4) = '2020') AS difference
FROM budget b 
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id 
WHERE substr(e.event_date, 1, 4) IN ('2019', '2020')
LIMIT 1

SELECT notes 
FROM income 
WHERE source = 'Fundraising' 
AND date_received = '2019-09-14'

SELECT m.phone
FROM member m
WHERE m.first_name = 'Carlo' AND m.last_name = 'Jacobs'

SELECT DISTINCT e."status"
FROM "expense" exp

JOIN "event" e ON b."link_to_event" = e."event_id"

FROM member mem

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM member m
JOIN major maj ON m.link_to_major = maj.major_id
WHERE maj.major_name = 'Business' 
AND m.t_shirt_size = 'Medium'

SELECT DISTINCT m.department
FROM member mem
JOIN major m ON mem.link_to_major = m.major_id
WHERE mem.position = 'President'

SELECT i.date_received
FROM income i
JOIN member m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE m.first_name = 'Connor' 
  AND m.last_name = 'Hilton'
  AND i.source = 'Dues'

SELECT 
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN b.amount ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) / 
  SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'October Meeting' THEN b.amount ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE b.category = 'Advertisement'
  AND e.event_name IN ('Yearly Kickoff', 'October Meeting')
GROUP BY b.category
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN b.amount ELSE 0 END) > 
       SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'October Meeting' THEN b.amount ELSE 0 END)

FROM expense 
WHERE expense_description = 'Pizza'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT city)

FROM member mem

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM attendance 
JOIN event ON attendance.link_to_event = event.event_id 
WHERE event.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer'

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE mj.department = 'School of Applied Sciences, Technology and Education'

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
WHERE e.status = 'Closed'
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
ORDER BY SUM(b.spent) * 1.0 / SUM(b.amount) DESC

SELECT MAX(total_spent) AS highest_amount
FROM (
    SELECT SUM(b.spent) AS total_spent
    FROM budget b
    GROUP BY b.link_to_event

SELECT SUM(spent) 
FROM budget

FROM member m

FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member

JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id

AND e.approved = 'true'

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN expense exp ON e.event_id = exp.link_to_budget
GROUP BY e.event_name
ORDER BY SUM(exp.cost) DESC, e.event_name ASC
LIMIT 1

    (SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN exp.cost ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(exp.cost)) AS percentage
FROM expense exp
JOIN attendance a ON exp.link_to_member = a.link_to_member
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' OR e.event_name IS NOT NULL

FROM income
WHERE date_received BETWEEN '2019-09-01' AND '2019-09-30'
GROUP BY source
ORDER BY SUM(amount) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM member m
JOIN major maj ON m.link_to_major = maj.major_id
WHERE maj.major_name = 'Physics Teaching'

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
WHERE b.category = 'Advertisement'
ORDER BY b.spent DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END
FROM attendance a
JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE m.first_name = 'Maya' 
  AND m.last_name = 'Mclean'
  AND e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer'

SELECT e.cost
FROM expense e
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
WHERE e.expense_description = 'Posters'
AND ev.event_name = 'September Speaker'

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
WHERE e.status = 'Closed'
GROUP BY e.event_name
HAVING SUM(b.remaining) < 0
ORDER BY SUM(b.remaining) ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT b.category, SUM(e.cost) AS total_value
FROM expense e
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
WHERE ev.event_name = 'October Meeting'
AND e.approved = 'true'
GROUP BY b.category

SELECT b.category, SUM(b.amount) AS amount_budgeted
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'April Speaker'
GROUP BY b.category
ORDER BY amount_budgeted ASC

SELECT SUM(cost) AS total_expense
FROM expense
WHERE expense_date = '2019-08-20'

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, SUM(e.cost) AS total_cost
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
WHERE m.member_id = 'rec4BLdZHS2Blfp4v'
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name

SELECT DISTINCT e.expense_description
FROM expense e
JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE m.first_name = 'Sacha' AND m.last_name = 'Harrison'

SELECT DISTINCT e.type
FROM event e
WHERE e.location = 'MU 215'

SELECT m.last_name, ma.department, ma.college
FROM member m
JOIN major ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id
WHERE m.position = 'Member' 
AND ma.major_name = 'Environmental Engineering'

SELECT DISTINCT b.category
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.location = 'MU 215'
AND e.type = 'Guest Speaker'
AND b.spent = 0

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN i.amount = 50 THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(m.member_id) AS percentage
FROM member m
JOIN income i ON m.member_id = i.link_to_member
WHERE m.t_shirt_size = 'Medium' AND m.position = 'Member'

SELECT event_name
FROM event
WHERE type = 'Game' 
  AND status = 'Closed'
  AND event_date BETWEEN '2019-03-15' AND '2020-03-20'

SELECT DISTINCT m.first_name, m.last_name, m.phone
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
WHERE e.cost > (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense)

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, e.cost
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
WHERE e.expense_description = 'Water, Veggie tray, supplies'

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, i.amount
FROM income i
JOIN member m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE i.date_received = '2019-09-09'

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / 
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M' 
    AND Admission IN ('+', '-')

SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', Birthday) > '1930' THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'

SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN p.Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) AS REAL) / 
    COUNT(CASE WHEN p.Admission = '-' THEN 1 END) AS ratio
FROM Patient p
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SLE'

SELECT p."Diagnosis", l."Date"
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p."ID" = l."ID"
WHERE p."ID" = 30609

SELECT DISTINCT p."ID", p."SEX", p."Birthday"
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p."ID" = l."ID"
WHERE l."LDH" >= 500

SELECT p."ID", 
       (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p."Birthday")) - 
       (strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', p."Birthday")) AS age
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p."ID" = e."ID"
WHERE e."RVVT" = '+'

SELECT p."ID", p."SEX", p."Diagnosis"
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p."ID" = e."ID"
WHERE e."Thrombosis" = 2

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Patient 
WHERE SEX = 'F' 
AND strftime('%Y', "First Date") = '1997' 
AND Admission = '-'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Examination e
JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE e."Thrombosis" = 1 
AND strftime('%Y', e."Examination Date") = '1997'
AND p."SEX" = 'F'

SELECT e."Symptoms", p."Diagnosis"
FROM Examination e
JOIN Patient p ON e."ID" = p."ID"
WHERE e."Symptoms" IS NOT NULL
AND p."Birthday" = (
    SELECT MAX("Birthday")
    FROM Patient
)

SELECT 
    MAX(p.Birthday) as oldest_birthday,
    MAX(l.Date) as last_lab_date,
    (strftime('%Y', p."First Date") - strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) - 
     (strftime('%m-%d', p."First Date") < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday))) as age_when_first_arrived
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
GROUP BY p.ID
ORDER BY p.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) AS ratio
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE (p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= 8.0) OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= 6.5)

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Examination e
JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) + 18 > strftime('%Y', e."Examination Date")
AND strftime('%Y', e."Examination Date") BETWEEN '1990' AND '1993'

SELECT 
    CAST(strftime('%Y', l."Date") AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p."Birthday") AS INTEGER) - 
    CASE 
        WHEN strftime('%m-%d', l."Date") < strftime('%m-%d', p."Birthday") THEN 1 
        ELSE 0 
    END AS age,
    p."Diagnosis"
FROM "Laboratory" l
JOIN "Patient" p ON l."ID" = p."ID"
WHERE l."HGB" = (SELECT MAX("HGB") FROM "Laboratory")

SELECT e."aCL IgM"
FROM Examination e
JOIN Patient p ON e."ID" = p."ID"
WHERE p."Diagnosis" = 'SLE' 
  AND p."Description" = '1994-02-19'
  AND e."Examination Date" = '1993-11-12'

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN l.Date LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN l."T-CHO" ELSE 0 END) - 
     SUM(CASE WHEN l.Date LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN l."T-CHO" ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / 
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.Date LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN l."T-CHO" ELSE 0 END) AS decrease_rate
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p."ID" = l."ID"
WHERE p."Birthday" = '1959-02-18'
    AND (l.Date LIKE '1981-11-%' OR l.Date LIKE '1981-12-%')
    AND SUM(CASE WHEN l.Date LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN l."T-CHO" ELSE 0 END) > 0

SELECT DISTINCT e."ID"
FROM Examination e
JOIN Laboratory l ON e."ID" = l."ID"
WHERE e."Examination Date" BETWEEN '1987-07-06' AND '1996-01-31'
  AND l."GPT" > 30
  AND l."ALB" < 4
ORDER BY e."ID"

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Examination 
WHERE Thrombosis = 2 
  AND "ANA Pattern" = 'S' 
  AND "aCL IgM" > (SELECT AVG("aCL IgM") * 1.2 FROM Examination WHERE Thrombosis = 2 AND "ANA Pattern" = 'S')

SELECT DISTINCT p."ID"
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p."ID" = l."ID"
WHERE p."Admission" = '-'
AND l."Date" LIKE '1991-10%'
AND l."T-BIL" < 2.0

SELECT AVG(l.ALB) 
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F' 
  AND p.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND l.PLT > 400

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Patient 
WHERE SEX = 'F' AND Diagnosis = 'APS'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Patient p
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) = '1980' AND p.Diagnosis = 'RA'

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN l."UA" > 8.0 AND p."SEX" = 'M' THEN 'true'
        WHEN l."UA" > 6.5 AND p."SEX" = 'F' THEN 'true'
        ELSE 'false'
    END AS uric_acid_normal_range
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l."ID" = p."ID"
WHERE l."ID" = 57266

SELECT DISTINCT p."ID"
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p."ID" = l."ID"
WHERE p."SEX" = 'M' 
AND l."GPT" >= 60

SELECT e."Diagnosis"
FROM Examination e
JOIN Laboratory l ON e."ID" = l."ID"
JOIN Patient p ON e."ID" = p."ID"
WHERE l."GPT" >= 60
ORDER BY p."Birthday" DESC

SELECT p."ID", p."SEX", p."Birthday"
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p."ID" = l."ID"
WHERE l."UN" = 29

SELECT 
    p."SEX",
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p."ID") AS patient_group
FROM 
    Patient p
JOIN 
    Laboratory l ON p."ID" = l."ID"
WHERE 
    l."T-BIL" >= 2.0
GROUP BY 
    p."SEX"

SELECT AVG(CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p."Birthday") AS INTEGER) - 
           (CASE WHEN strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', p."Birthday") THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS average_age
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p."ID" = l."ID"
WHERE p."SEX" = 'M' 
  AND l."T-CHO" >= 250

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p."ID") 
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p."ID" = l."ID"
WHERE l."TG" >= 200 
AND date(p."Birthday", "+50 years") < date('now')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p."ID")
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p."ID" = l."ID"
WHERE strftime('%Y', p."Birthday") BETWEEN '1936' AND '1956'
  AND p."SEX" = 'M'
  AND l."CPK" >= 250

SELECT DISTINCT p."ID", p."SEX", 
       CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p."Birthday") AS INTEGER) - 
       CASE WHEN strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', p."Birthday") THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p."ID" = l."ID"
WHERE l."GLU" >= 180 
  AND l."T-CHO" < 250

SELECT DISTINCT p."ID", (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p."Birthday") - (strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', p."Birthday"))) AS age, p."Diagnosis"
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p."ID" = l."ID"
WHERE l."RBC" < 3.5
ORDER BY p."ID"

SELECT p."ID", p."SEX"
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p."ID" = l."ID"
WHERE p."Diagnosis" = 'SLE' 
AND l."HGB" > 10 
AND l."HGB" < 17
ORDER BY p."Birthday" ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT p."ID", 
       (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p."Birthday")) - 
       (strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', p."Birthday")) AS age
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p."ID" = l."ID"
WHERE l."HCT" >= 52
  AND p."ID" IN (
    SELECT "ID"
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY "ID"
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
  )

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS platelet_difference
FROM Laboratory
WHERE PLT < 100 OR PLT > 400

SELECT DISTINCT p."ID"
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p."ID" = l."ID"
WHERE strftime('%Y', l."Date") = '1984'
  AND date(p."Birthday", '+50 years') > date('now')
  AND l."PLT" BETWEEN 100 AND 400

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE date(p.Birthday, '+55 years') < date('now')
AND l.PT >= 14
GROUP BY p.ID
HAVING COUNT(l.ID) >= 1
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p."ID")
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p."ID" = l."ID"
WHERE p."SEX" = 'M'
  AND l."WBC" > 3.5
  AND l."WBC" < 9.0
  AND (l."FG" <= 150 OR l."FG" >= 450)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l."ID") 
FROM Laboratory l 
WHERE l."IGG" >= 2000

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Examination e ON l.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.IGG > 900 AND l.IGG < 2000 
AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p."ID")
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p."ID" = l."ID"
WHERE p."First Date" > '1990-01-01'
AND l."IGA" > 80
AND l."IGA" < 500

SELECT "Diagnosis"
FROM "Examination"
WHERE "aCL IgM" <= 40 OR "aCL IgM" >= 400
GROUP BY "Diagnosis"
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p."ID" = l."ID"
WHERE l."CRP" = '+' 
AND p."Description" IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.CRE >= 1.5 
AND date(p.Birthday, '+70 years') > date('now')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p."ID")
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p."ID" = l."ID"
WHERE l."RNP" IN ('-', '+-') 
AND p."Admission" = '+'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Examination 
WHERE "SM" IN ('-', '+-') AND "Thrombosis" = 0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p."ID")
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p."ID" = l."ID"
WHERE l."SC170" IN ('negative', '0')
AND p."SEX" = 'F'
AND p."ID" NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT e."ID"
    FROM Examination e
    WHERE e."Symptoms" IS NOT NULL
    AND e."Symptoms" != ''
)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p."ID")
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p."ID" = l."ID"
WHERE l."CENTROMEA" IN ('negative', '0')
AND l."SSB" IN ('negative', '0')
AND p."SEX" = 'M'

SELECT MAX(Patient.Birthday) 
FROM Patient 
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID 
WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.CPK < 250 
AND (e.KCT = '+' OR e.RVVT = '+' OR e.LAC = '+')

SELECT l.name
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY l.name
ORDER BY SUM(m.home_team_goal + m.away_team_goal) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT t.team_long_name
FROM Match m
JOIN Team t ON m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE l.name = 'Scotland Premier League'
AND m.season = '2009/2010'
AND m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal
GROUP BY t.team_long_name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT buildUpPlaySpeed
FROM Team_Attributes
WHERE team_api_id IN (
    SELECT team_api_id
    FROM Team_Attributes
    WHERE date = (
        SELECT MAX(date)
        FROM Team_Attributes ta2
        WHERE ta2.team_api_id = Team_Attributes.team_api_id
    )
    ORDER BY buildUpPlaySpeed DESC
    LIMIT 4
)
AND date = (
    SELECT MAX(date)
    FROM Team_Attributes ta3
    WHERE ta3.team_api_id = Team_Attributes.team_api_id
)

SELECT l.name
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
  AND m.home_team_goal = m.away_team_goal
GROUP BY l.name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.birthday) AS INTEGER) - 
    (CAST(strftime('%m-%d', 'now') AS TEXT) < CAST(strftime('%m-%d', p.birthday) AS TEXT)) AS current_age
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE pa.sprint_speed >= 97
AND strftime('%Y', pa.date) BETWEEN '2013' AND '2015'
GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name, p.birthday

SELECT l.name, COUNT(m.id) as match_count
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
GROUP BY l.name
ORDER BY match_count DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT team_fifa_api_id
FROM Team_Attributes
WHERE buildUpPlaySpeed > 50 AND buildUpPlaySpeed < 60

SELECT DISTINCT t.team_long_name
FROM Team t
JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', ta.date) = '2012'
AND ta.buildUpPlayPassing > (
    SELECT AVG(buildUpPlayPassing)
    FROM Team_Attributes
    WHERE buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
    AND strftime('%Y', date) = '2012'
)

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN pa.preferred_foot = 'left' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT pa.player_fifa_api_id) AS percentage_left_footed
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_fifa_api_id = p.player_fifa_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.birthday) BETWEEN '1987' AND '1992'

SELECT AVG(pa.long_shots) AS average_long_shots
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Ahmed Samir Farag'

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.height > 180
GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY AVG(pa.heading_accuracy) DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT DISTINCT l.name
FROM League l
JOIN Match m ON l.id = m.league_id
WHERE m.season = '2009/2010'
GROUP BY l.id, l.name
HAVING AVG(m.home_team_goal) > AVG(m.away_team_goal)

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
WHERE substr(birthday, 1, 7) = '1970-10'

SELECT pa.overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Gabriel Tamas'
AND strftime('%Y', pa.date) = '2011'

SELECT AVG(m.home_team_goal) AS average_home_team_goal
FROM Match m
JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id
WHERE c.name = 'Poland' AND m.season = '2010/2011'

SELECT CASE 
    WHEN p1.height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player) THEN 'highest'
    WHEN p1.height = (SELECT MIN(height) FROM Player) THEN 'shortest'
END
FROM Player p1
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p1.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p1.height IN ((SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player), (SELECT MIN(height) FROM Player))
GROUP BY p1.height
ORDER BY AVG(pa.finishing) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(t2.overall_rating) AS average_overall_rating
FROM Player t1
JOIN Player_Attributes t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', t2.date) >= '2010' 
  AND strftime('%Y', t2.date) <= '2015'
  AND t1.height > 170

SELECT 
  (SELECT AVG(pa.ball_control) 
   FROM Player_Attributes pa 
   JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id 
   WHERE p.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo') 
  - 
  (SELECT AVG(pa.ball_control) 
   FROM Player_Attributes pa 
   JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id 
   WHERE p.player_name = 'Aaron Appindangoye') AS difference
FROM Player_Attributes pa 
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id 
WHERE p.player_name IN ('Abdou Diallo', 'Aaron Appindangoye')
LIMIT 1

SELECT player_name 
FROM Player 
WHERE player_name IN ('Aaron Lennon', 'Abdelaziz Barrada') 
ORDER BY birthday ASC 
LIMIT 1

SELECT player_name 
FROM Player 
WHERE height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id)
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE preferred_foot = 'left' 
AND attacking_work_rate = 'low'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id)
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.birthday) < '1986'
AND pa.defensive_work_rate = 'High'

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE pa.volleys > 70 AND pa.dribbling > 70

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE l.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League' 
AND SUBSTR(m.date, 1, 7) = '2009-04'

SELECT l.name
FROM League l
JOIN Match m ON l.id = m.league_id
WHERE m.season = '2008/2009'
GROUP BY l.name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    ((MAX(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk' THEN pa.overall_rating END) - 
      MAX(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Paulin Puel' THEN pa.overall_rating END)) * 100.0 / 
     MAX(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Paulin Puel' THEN pa.overall_rating END)) AS percentage_difference
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name IN ('Ariel Borysiuk', 'Paulin Puel')
AND pa.date = (
    SELECT MAX(date) 
    FROM Player_Attributes pa2 
    JOIN Player p2 ON pa2.player_api_id = p2.player_api_id 
    WHERE p2.player_name IN ('Ariel Borysiuk', 'Paulin Puel')
)

SELECT AVG(pa.overall_rating) AS average_overall_rating
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Pietro Marino'

SELECT MAX(ta.chanceCreationPassing) AS highest_score, ta.chanceCreationPassingClass AS classification
FROM Team_Attributes ta
JOIN Team t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE t.team_long_name = 'Ajax'

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE pa.overall_rating = 77 
AND pa.date LIKE '2016-06-23%'
ORDER BY p.birthday ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT pa.overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Aaron Mooy'
AND pa.date LIKE '2016-02-04%'

SELECT pa.attacking_work_rate
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Francesco Migliore'
AND pa.date LIKE '2015-05-01%'

SELECT pa.date
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Kevin Constant'
AND pa.crossing = (
    SELECT MAX(pa2.crossing)
    FROM Player_Attributes pa2
    JOIN Player p2 ON pa2.player_api_id = p2.player_api_id
    WHERE p2.player_name = 'Kevin Constant'
)
LIMIT 1

SELECT ta.buildUpPlayPassingClass
FROM Team_Attributes ta
JOIN Team t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE t.team_long_name = 'FC Lorient'
AND ta.date LIKE '2010-02-22%'

SELECT ta.defenceAggressionClass
FROM Team t
JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
WHERE t.team_long_name = 'Hannover 96'
AND ta.date LIKE '2015-09-10%'

SELECT AVG(pa.overall_rating) 
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic'
AND substr(pa.date, 1, 10) BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21'

SELECT 
  ((MAX(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Landon Donovan' THEN pa.overall_rating END) - 
    MAX(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery' THEN pa.overall_rating END)) * 100.0 / 
   MAX(CASE WHEN p.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery' THEN pa.overall_rating END)) AS percentage
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE pa.date = '2013-07-12 00:00:00'
  AND p.player_name IN ('Landon Donovan', 'Jordan Bowery')

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player p
WHERE p.height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player)
LIMIT 1

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE pa.overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes)

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE pa.attacking_work_rate = 'high'

SELECT DISTINCT t.team_short_name
FROM Team t
JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
WHERE ta.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Safe'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Player 
WHERE player_name LIKE 'Aaron%' 
AND STRFTIME('%Y', birthday) > '1990'
SELECT (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 6) - (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 23) AS jumping_difference

SELECT "id"
FROM "Player_Attributes"
WHERE "preferred_foot" = 'right'
ORDER BY "potential" ASC
LIMIT 4

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Player_Attributes 
WHERE crossing = (SELECT MAX(crossing) FROM Player_Attributes) 
AND preferred_foot = 'left'

SELECT m.home_team_goal, m.away_team_goal
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE m.date LIKE '2008-09-24%'
AND l.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League'

SELECT DISTINCT ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM Team_Attributes ta
JOIN Team t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE t.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge'

SELECT pa.finishing, pa.curve
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.weight = (SELECT MAX(weight) FROM Player)

SELECT l.name
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'

ORDER BY COUNT(m.id) DESC
LIMIT 4

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Match M
JOIN Team T ON M.away_team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE M.away_team_goal = (SELECT MAX(away_team_goal) FROM Match)

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE pa.overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes)
LIMIT 1

SELECT (COUNT(CASE WHEN pa.overall_rating > 70 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS percentage
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.height < 180

AND q.q2 IS NULL
AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL

SELECT d.surname
FROM qualifying q
JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE q.raceId = 19
ORDER BY q.q2 ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT r.name
FROM races r
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE c.country = 'Germany'

SELECT c.lat, c.lng
FROM circuits c
JOIN races r ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
WHERE r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'

SELECT c.lat, c.lng
FROM races r
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE r.name = 'Abu Dhabi Grand Prix'

SELECT q.q1
FROM qualifying q
JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Bruno' 
AND d.surname = 'Senna'
AND q.raceId = 354

SELECT q.number
FROM qualifying q
WHERE q.raceId = 903 
AND q.q3 LIKE '0:01:54%'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
JOIN status s ON r.statusId = s.statusId
WHERE ra.name = 'Bahrain Grand Prix' 
AND ra.year = 2007
AND s.status NOT LIKE 'Finished%'

SELECT d.forename, d.surname
FROM drivers d
JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
WHERE r.raceId = 592 
AND r.time IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY d.dob ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, d.url
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE lt.raceId = 161 
AND lt.time LIKE '1:27%'
AND lt.lap = 1

SELECT c.lat, c.lng
FROM races r
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE r.name = 'Malaysian Grand Prix'

SELECT c.url
FROM constructors c
JOIN constructorResults cr ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId
WHERE cr.raceId = 9
ORDER BY cr.points DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT d.code
FROM qualifying q
JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE q.raceId = 45 
AND q.q3 = '0:01:33'

SELECT s.url
FROM seasons s
JOIN races r ON s.year = r.year
WHERE r.raceId = 901

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, d.dob
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN status s ON r.statusId = s.statusId
WHERE r.raceId = 872
AND s.status LIKE 'Finished%'
ORDER BY d.dob DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT d.nationality
FROM drivers d
JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
WHERE r.fastestLapSpeed = (SELECT MAX(fastestLapSpeed) FROM results)

SELECT 
    ((MAX(CASE WHEN r.raceId = 853 THEN CAST(REPLACE(r.fastestLapSpeed, ',', '.') AS REAL) END) - 
      MAX(CASE WHEN r.raceId = 854 THEN CAST(REPLACE(r.fastestLapSpeed, ',', '.') AS REAL) END)) * 100.0) / 
     MAX(CASE WHEN r.raceId = 854 THEN CAST(REPLACE(r.fastestLapSpeed, ',', '.') AS REAL) END) AS percentage
FROM drivers d
JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Paul' 
  AND d.surname = 'di Resta'
  AND r.raceId IN (853, 854)

SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN r.status IN ('Finished', 'Disqualified') OR r.status LIKE '+% Lap%' THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE ra.date = '1983-07-16'

SELECT name
FROM races
WHERE year = (SELECT MIN(strftime('%Y', date)) FROM races)
AND strftime('%m', date) = (SELECT MIN(strftime('%m', date)) FROM races WHERE year = (SELECT MIN(strftime('%Y', date)) FROM races))

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, SUM(r.points) as total_points
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname
ORDER BY total_points DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    lt.milliseconds AS best_lap_time,
    d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver,
    r.name AS race
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE lt.milliseconds = (SELECT MIN(milliseconds) FROM lapTimes)

SELECT AVG(lt.milliseconds) as average_lap_time
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' 
AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
AND r.year = 2009
AND r.name = 'Malaysian Grand Prix'

SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN r.position > 1 THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE d.surname = 'Hamilton' 
AND ra.year >= 2010

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality, MAX(ds.points) as max_points
FROM drivers d
JOIN driverStandings ds ON d.driverId = ds.driverId
GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality
ORDER BY COUNT(ds.wins) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', dob)) - 
    (strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', dob)) AS age,
    forename,
    surname
FROM drivers
WHERE nationality = 'Japanese'
ORDER BY dob DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT r.name AS race_name, c.name AS circuit_name, c.location
FROM races r
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE strftime('%Y', r.date) = '2005' AND strftime('%m', r.date) = '09'

SELECT r.name
FROM drivers d
JOIN driverStandings ds ON d.driverId = ds.driverId
JOIN races r ON ds.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE d.forename = 'Alex' 
AND d.surname = 'Yoong'
AND ds.position < 20

SELECT r.name, r.year
FROM races r
JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId

      CAST(SUBSTR(r1.time, INSTR(r1.time, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000) -
     (CAST(SUBSTR(r2.time, 1, INSTR(r2.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 3600 + 
      CAST(SUBSTR(r2.time, INSTR(r2.time, ':') + 1, INSTR(r2.time, ':', INSTR(r2.time, ':') + 1) - INSTR(r2.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 + 
      CAST(SUBSTR(r2.time, INSTR(r2.time, ':', INSTR(r2.time, ':') + 1) + 1, INSTR(r2.time, '.') - INSTR(r2.time, ':', INSTR(r2.time, ':') + 1) - 1) AS REAL) + 
      CAST(SUBSTR(r2.time, INSTR(r2.time, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000)) /
    (CAST(SUBSTR(r2.time, 1, INSTR(r2.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 3600 + 
     CAST(SUBSTR(r2.time, INSTR(r2.time, ':') + 1, INSTR(r2.time, ':', INSTR(r2.time, ':') + 1) - INSTR(r2.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 +

     CAST(SUBSTR(r2.time, INSTR(r2.time, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000) * 100 AS percentage_faster

    SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id
    FROM atom a
    INNER JOIN carcinogenic_molecules cm ON a.molecule_id = cm.molecule_id
    WHERE a.element = 'f'
),
carcinogenic_without_fluorine AS (
    SELECT cm.molecule_id
    FROM carcinogenic_molecules cm
    LEFT JOIN molecules_with_fluorine mf ON cm.molecule_id = mf.molecule_id

)

WITH segment_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Segment,
        AVG(ym.Consumption) AS avg_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE ym.Date LIKE '2013%'
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
segment_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_consumption END) AS sme_avg,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_consumption END) AS lam_avg,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_consumption END) AS kam_avg
    FROM segment_consumption
)
SELECT 
    (sme_avg - lam_avg) AS sme_lam_diff,

    (kam_avg - sme_avg) AS kam_sme_diff

WITH consumption_by_segment AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Segment,
        SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) as Year,
        SUM(ym.Consumption) as TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' 
        AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
        AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4)
),
consumption_2012 AS (
    SELECT Segment, TotalConsumption as Consumption2012
    FROM consumption_by_segment
    WHERE Year = '2012'
),
consumption_2013 AS (
    SELECT Segment, TotalConsumption as Consumption2013
    FROM consumption_by_segment
    WHERE Year = '2013'
)
SELECT 
    c2012.Segment,
    CASE 
        WHEN c2012.Consumption2012 = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ((c2013.Consumption2013 - c2012.Consumption2012) / c2012.Consumption2012) * 100

FROM consumption_2012 c2012

WITH lam_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.CustomerID
    FROM customers c
    WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM'
),
lam_consumption AS (
    SELECT yc.CustomerID
    FROM yearmonth yc
    JOIN lam_customers lc ON yc.CustomerID = lc.CustomerID
    WHERE yc.Consumption > 46.73
    GROUP BY yc.CustomerID
)
SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT lc.CustomerID) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) AS percentage
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN lam_consumption lc ON c.CustomerID = lc.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM'

WITH customers_on_date AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k t
    WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25'
),
total_customers AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count
    FROM customers_on_date
),
eur_customers AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) as eur_count
    FROM customers_on_date c
    JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
    JOIN customers cust ON c.CustomerID = cust.CustomerID
    WHERE t.Date = '2012-08-25' AND cust.Currency = 'EUR'
)
SELECT CAST(eur_count AS FLOAT) * 100 / total_count AS percentage
FROM total_customers, eur_customers

WITH customer_transaction AS (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE Date = '2012-08-25' AND Price = 634.8
),
customer_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '2012%' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '2013%' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE CustomerID IN (SELECT CustomerID FROM customer_transaction)
    GROUP BY CustomerID
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN consumption_2012 > 0 THEN (consumption_2012 - consumption_2013) / consumption_2012
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS consumption_decrease_rate
FROM customer_consumption

WITH customer_spending AS (
    SELECT 
        t."CustomerID",
        SUM(t."Price") as total_spent,
        SUM(t."Price") / SUM(t."Amount") as avg_price_per_item
    FROM transactions_1k t
    GROUP BY t."CustomerID"
),
top_customer AS (
    SELECT "CustomerID", total_spent, avg_price_per_item
    FROM customer_spending
    ORDER BY total_spent DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    tc."CustomerID",
    tc.avg_price_per_item,
    c."Currency"
FROM top_customer tc
JOIN customers c ON tc."CustomerID" = c."CustomerID"

WITH race_info AS (
    SELECT raceId 
    FROM races 
    WHERE year = 1988 AND circuitId = (
        SELECT circuitId FROM circuits WHERE circuitId = (
            SELECT DISTINCT circuitId FROM races WHERE year = 1988 LIMIT 1
        )
    ) LIMIT 1
),
finished_drivers AS (
    SELECT r.driverId, r.position, r.time, r.statusId,
           s.status
    FROM results r
    JOIN status s ON r.statusId = s.statusId
    WHERE r.raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM race_info)
      AND s.status LIKE 'Finished%'
    ORDER BY r.position
),
champion_time AS (
    SELECT time 
    FROM finished_drivers 
    WHERE position = 1
),
last_finisher_time AS (
    SELECT time 
    FROM finished_drivers 
    WHERE position = (SELECT MAX(position) FROM finished_drivers)
)
SELECT 
    CAST(
        ((julianday((SELECT time FROM last_finisher_time)) - julianday((SELECT time FROM champion_time))) * 100) 
        AS REAL
    ) AS percentage_faster
FROM race_info

WITH segment_consumption AS (

    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE ym.Date LIKE '2013%'
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
segment_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_consumption END) AS sme_avg,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_consumption END) AS lam_avg,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_consumption END) AS kam_avg
    FROM segment_consumption
)
SELECT 
    (sme_avg - lam_avg) AS sme_lam_diff,
    (lam_avg - kam_avg) AS lam_kam_diff,
    (kam_avg - sme_avg) AS kam_sme_diff
FROM segment_averages

        c.Segment,
        SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) as Year,
        SUM(ym.Consumption) as TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' 
        AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
        AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4)
),
consumption_2012 AS (
    SELECT Segment, TotalConsumption as Consumption2012
    FROM consumption_by_segment
    WHERE Year = '2012'
),
consumption_2013 AS (
    SELECT Segment, TotalConsumption as Consumption2013
    FROM consumption_by_segment
    WHERE Year = '2013'
)
SELECT 
    c2012.Segment,
    CASE 
        WHEN c2012.Consumption2012 = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ((c2013.Consumption2013 - c2012.Consumption2012) / c2012.Consumption2012) * 100
    END as PercentageIncrease
FROM consumption_2012 c2012
JOIN consumption_2013 c2013 ON c2012.Segment = c2013.Segment
ORDER BY c2012.Segment

SELECT d.driverId
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE r.raceId = 872 
AND r.statusId IN (SELECT statusId FROM status WHERE status LIKE 'Finished%')

LIMIT 1

SELECT d.nationality
FROM drivers d
JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId

SELECT 
    ((CAST(SUBSTR(r1.fastestLapSpeed, 1, LENGTH(r1.fastestLapSpeed) - 3) AS REAL) - 
      CAST(SUBSTR(r2.fastestLapSpeed, 1, LENGTH(r2.fastestLapSpeed) - 3) AS REAL)) * 100.0 / 
     CAST(SUBSTR(r2.fastestLapSpeed, 1, LENGTH(r2.fastestLapSpeed) - 3) AS REAL)) AS percentage_faster
FROM results r1
JOIN results r2 ON r1.driverId = r2.driverId
JOIN drivers d ON r1.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Paul' 
  AND d.surname = 'di Resta'
  AND r1.raceId = 853
  AND r2.raceId = 854

FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
JOIN status s ON r.statusId = s.statusId

FROM drivers d
JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId

SELECT

    r.name AS race
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE lt.milliseconds = (SELECT MIN(milliseconds) FROM lapTimes)

SELECT AVG(lt.milliseconds) as average_lap_time
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN drivers d ON lt.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' 
  AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
  AND r.year = 2009

FROM results r

WITH race_info AS (
    SELECT raceId 
    FROM races 
    WHERE year = 1988
),
champion_time AS (
    SELECT r.time as champion_time
    FROM results r
    JOIN race_info ri ON r.raceId = ri.raceId
    WHERE r.position = 1
),
last_finisher_time AS (
    SELECT r.time as last_time
    FROM results r
    JOIN race_info ri ON r.raceId = ri.raceId
    JOIN status s ON r.statusId = s.statusId
    WHERE s.status LIKE 'Finished%'
    ORDER BY r.position DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    CAST(
        (julianday(l.last_time) - julianday(c.champion_time)) * 100 AS REAL
    ) AS percentage_faster
FROM champion_time c, last_finisher_time l

SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN s.status LIKE 'Finished%' THEN d.driverId END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(d.driverId) AS completion_percentage
FROM drivers d
JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
JOIN status s ON r.statusId = s.statusId

SELECT 
    r.year,
    AVG(CAST(SUBSTR(res.time, 1, INSTR(res.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 3600 + 
        CAST(SUBSTR(res.time, INSTR(res.time, ':') + 1, INSTR(res.time, ':', INSTR(res.time, ':') + 1) - INSTR(res.time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 + 
        CAST(SUBSTR(res.time, INSTR(res.time, ':', INSTR(res.time, ':') + 1) + 1) AS REAL)) AS avg_champion_time_seconds
FROM races r
JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE r.year < 1975 
    AND res.position = 1 
    AND res.time IS NOT NULL 
    AND res.time NOT LIKE '+%'
GROUP BY r.year
ORDER BY r.year

JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE (c.atom_id = 'TR009_12' OR c.atom_id2 = 'TR009_12')
AND b.molecule_id = 'TR009'

SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM connected 
WHERE atom_id LIKE 'TR%_19' OR atom_id2 LIKE 'TR%_19'

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR004'

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
AND SUBSTR(a.atom_id, 7, 2) BETWEEN '21' AND '25'

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_id
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE (a1.element = 'p' AND a2.element = 'n') OR (a1.element = 'n' AND a2.element = 'p')

SELECT m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN (
    SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) as double_bond_count
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '='
    GROUP BY molecule_id
    ORDER BY double_bond_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
) b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id

SELECT CAST(COUNT(b.bond_id) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) AS average_bonds
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'i'

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
WHERE a.atom_id NOT IN (SELECT atom_id FROM connected)

SELECT DISTINCT c.atom_id
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR041' 
AND b.bond_type = '#'

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR144_8_19'

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'

SELECT 
    ROUND(
        (COUNT(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN b.bond_id END) * 100.0) / 
        COUNT(b.bond_id), 
        5
    ) AS percentage
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM atom 
WHERE molecule_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE b.bond_type = '#' 
    AND (m.molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'p') 
         OR m.molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'br'))
)

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(a.atom_id) AS percent
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
)

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11'

SELECT (COUNT(CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS percentage
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'

SELECT a.element, COUNT(*) as tally
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' 
AND SUBSTR(a.atom_id, -2) = '_4'
GROUP BY a.element

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(*) AS ratio,
    m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR006'
GROUP BY m.label

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(a.atom_id) > 5

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.Virtual = 'F' AND ss.AvgScrMath > 400

SELECT CDSCode
FROM frpm
WHERE ("Enrollment (K-12)" + "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > 500

SELECT MAX(f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)") AS highest_eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm f
JOIN (
    SELECT s.cds, (s.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / s.NumTstTakr) AS excellence_rate
    FROM satscores s
    WHERE (s.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / s.NumTstTakr) > 0.3
) AS high_excellence ON f.CDSCode = high_excellence.cds

SELECT 
    s."CharterNum",
    ss."AvgScrWrite",
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss."AvgScrWrite" DESC) AS rank
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s."CDSCode" = ss."cds"
WHERE ss."AvgScrWrite" > 499
AND s."CharterNum" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY ss."AvgScrWrite" DESC

SELECT 
    s."School",
    s."Street"
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f."CDSCode" = s."CDSCode"
WHERE (f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > 30

SELECT DISTINCT s."School"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s."CDSCode" = f."CDSCode"
JOIN satscores ss ON s."CDSCode" = ss."cds"
WHERE f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" > 0.1
AND ss."NumGE1500" > 0

SELECT 
    s."School",
    s."FundingType"
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s."CDSCode" = ss."cds"
WHERE s."District" LIKE 'Riverside%'
AND ss."AvgScrMath" > 400

SELECT 
    s."School",
    s."Street",
    s."City",
    s."State",
    s."Zip"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s."CDSCode" = f."CDSCode"
WHERE s."GSserved" LIKE '%9-12%' 
    AND s."City" = 'Monterey'
    AND f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" > 800

SELECT 
    s."School",
    AVG(sc."AvgScrWrite") AS avg_writing_score,
    s."Phone" AS communication_number
FROM schools s
LEFT JOIN satscores sc ON s."CDSCode" = sc."cds"
WHERE s."OpenDate" > '1991-12-31' OR s."ClosedDate" < '2000-01-01'
GROUP BY s."School", s."Phone"

WITH avg_diff AS (
    SELECT AVG("Enrollment (K-12)" - "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") AS avg_difference
    FROM frpm
    JOIN schools ON frpm."CDSCode" = schools."CDSCode"
    WHERE schools."FundingType" = 'Locally funded'
)
SELECT schools."School", schools."DOCType"
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm."CDSCode" = schools."CDSCode"
CROSS JOIN avg_diff
WHERE schools."FundingType" = 'Locally funded'
AND ("Enrollment (K-12)" - "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > avg_diff.avg_difference

SELECT 
    "Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
ORDER BY "Enrollment (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 8

SELECT (frpm."FRPM Count (K-12)" / frpm."Enrollment (K-12)") AS eligible_free_meal_rate
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm."CDSCode" = schools."CDSCode"
WHERE schools."SOC" = '66'
ORDER BY frpm."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE ss.NumTstTakr > 0
ORDER BY CAST(ss.NumGE1500 AS FLOAT) / ss.NumTstTakr ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    s."AdmFName1" || ' ' || s."AdmLName1" AS admin_full_name
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s."CDSCode" = ss."cds"
WHERE ss."NumGE1500" = (SELECT MAX("NumGE1500") FROM satscores)

SELECT AVG(satscores.NumTstTakr) 
FROM schools 
JOIN satscores ON schools.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE schools.OpenDate BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1980-12-31'
AND schools.School LIKE '%Fresno%'

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.District = 'Fresno Unified'
ORDER BY ss.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT "School"
FROM (
    SELECT "School", 
           "County",
           AVG("AvgScrRead") as avg_reading_score,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "County" ORDER BY AVG("AvgScrRead") DESC) as rank
    FROM schools
    JOIN satscores ON schools."CDSCode" = satscores."cds"
    WHERE "Virtual" = 'F'
    GROUP BY "School", "County"
)
WHERE rank <= 5
ORDER BY "County", avg_reading_score DESC

SELECT 
    s."School",
    ss."AvgScrWrite"
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s."CDSCode" = ss."cds"
WHERE s."AdmLName1" = 'Ulrich' OR s."AdmLName2" = 'Ulrich' OR s."AdmLName3" = 'Ulrich'

SELECT s."School", f."Enrollment (K-12)"
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f."CDSCode" = s."CDSCode"
WHERE s."DOC" = '31'
ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) / 12.0 AS monthly_average
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Alameda' 
  AND DOC = '52' 
  AND strftime('%Y', OpenDate) = '1980'

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN s.DOC = '54' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / 
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.DOC = '52' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ratio
FROM schools s
WHERE s.District LIKE '%Orange County%'

SELECT s."Street", s."School"
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s."CDSCode" = ss."cds"
ORDER BY ss."AvgScrMath" DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM frpm 
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode 
WHERE schools.County = 'Los Angeles' 
AND frpm."Charter School (Y/N)" = 0 
AND (frpm."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100 / frpm."Enrollment (K-12)") < 0.18

SELECT SUM(f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") AS total_enrollment
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f."CDSCode" = s."CDSCode"
WHERE s."EdOpsCode" = 'SSS' 
  AND s."SOC" = '65'
  AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'

SELECT 
    s."School",
    f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)"
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    frpm f ON s."CDSCode" = f."CDSCode"
WHERE 
    s."County" = 'Los Angeles' 
    AND s."GSserved" = 'K-9'
    AND f."Academic Year" = (SELECT MAX("Academic Year") FROM frpm)
ORDER BY 
    s."School"

SELECT 
    s."County",
    COUNT(*) as school_count
FROM schools s
WHERE s."County" IN ('San Diego', 'Santa Barbara')
    AND s."Virtual" = 'F'
GROUP BY s."County"
ORDER BY school_count DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT "GSoffered"
FROM schools
WHERE "Longitude" = (
    SELECT MAX("Longitude")
    FROM schools
)

SELECT 
    s."City",
    COUNT(*) AS school_count
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s."CDSCode" = f."CDSCode"
WHERE s."GSoffered" = 'K-8' 
    AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Multiple Provision Types'
GROUP BY s."City"

SELECT f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)", f."District Code"
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f."CDSCode" = s."CDSCode"
WHERE s."AdmFName1" = 'Alusine'
   OR s."AdmFName2" = 'Alusine'
   OR s."AdmFName3" = 'Alusine'

SELECT "AdmEmail1", "AdmEmail2"
FROM schools
WHERE "County" = 'San Bernardino'
AND "City" = 'San Bernardino'
AND "OpenDate" BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2010-12-31'
AND "SOC" = '62'
AND "DOC" = '54'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' 
AND d.A3 = 'East Bohemia'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id)
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F' 
AND d.A11 > 6000 
AND d.A11 < 10000

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M' 
AND d.A3 = 'north Bohemia'
AND d.A11 > 8000

SELECT 
    (SELECT d.account_id 
     FROM client c
     JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
     WHERE c.gender = 'F'
     ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC
     LIMIT 1) AS oldest_female_account,
    (SELECT MAX(A11) - MIN(A11) 
     FROM district) AS salary_gap

WITH youngest_client AS (
    SELECT c.client_id, c.birth_date, c.district_id
    FROM client c
    WHERE c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client)
),
district_avg_salary AS (
    SELECT d.district_id, d.A11 as avg_salary
    FROM district d
),
client_with_salary AS (
    SELECT yc.client_id, yc.birth_date, yc.district_id, das.avg_salary
    FROM youngest_client yc
    JOIN district_avg_salary das ON yc.district_id = das.district_id
),
account_info AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.account_id as account_number, cws.district_id, cws.avg_salary
    FROM account a
    JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    JOIN client_with_salary cws ON d.client_id = cws.client_id
)
SELECT ai.account_number
FROM account_info ai
WHERE ai.avg_salary = (
    SELECT MAX(avg_salary)
    FROM account_info
)
LIMIT 1

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.date LIKE '1997%'
AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
AND l.amount = (
    SELECT MIN(amount)
    FROM loan
    WHERE date LIKE '1997%'
)

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12 
AND a.date LIKE '1993%'
ORDER BY l.amount DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
AND dist.A2 = 'Sokolov'

SELECT d."A2"
FROM "client" c
JOIN "disp" dis ON c."client_id" = dis."client_id"
JOIN "account" a ON dis."account_id" = a."account_id"
JOIN "district" d ON a."district_id" = d."district_id"
WHERE c."gender" = 'F' 
AND c."birth_date" = '1976-01-29'

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_male_clients
FROM client c
WHERE c.district_id = (
    SELECT district_id 
    FROM district 
    WHERE A3 = 'south Bohemia' 
    ORDER BY CAST(A4 AS INTEGER) DESC 
    LIMIT 1
)

WITH first_loan_client AS (
    SELECT l.account_id
    FROM loan l
    WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05'
    LIMIT 1
),
balances AS (
    SELECT 
        MAX(CASE WHEN t.date = '1993-03-22' THEN t.balance END) as balance_1993_03_22,
        MAX(CASE WHEN t.date = '1998-12-27' THEN t.balance END) as balance_1998_12_27
    FROM trans t
    JOIN first_loan_client flc ON t.account_id = flc.account_id
    WHERE t.date IN ('1993-03-22', '1998-12-27')
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN balance_1993_03_22 IS NOT NULL AND balance_1998_12_27 IS NOT NULL AND balance_1993_03_22 != 0
        THEN ((balance_1998_12_27 - balance_1993_03_22) * 100.0 / balance_1993_03_22)
        ELSE NULL
    END as increase_rate
FROM balances

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / SUM(l.amount) AS percentage
FROM loan l

SELECT 
    (COUNT(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS percentage_running
FROM loan l
WHERE l.amount < 100000

SELECT ((d.A13 - d.A12) / d.A12) * 100 AS unemployment_increment_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D'

SELECT 
    d.A2 AS district,
    COUNT(c.client_id) AS female_clients
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY female_clients DESC
LIMIT 9

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.amount >= 250000 
AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
AND a.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id)
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.status = 'C' AND a.district_id = 1

WITH ranked_districts AS (
    SELECT 
        district_id,
        A15,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A15 DESC) as rank
    FROM district
),
second_highest AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM ranked_districts
    WHERE rank = 2
)
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client c
JOIN second_highest sh ON c.district_id = sh.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'

SELECT d.A2
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ' 
  AND t.operation = 'VYBER'
  AND t.date LIKE '1996-01%'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT DISTINCT t.account_id
FROM trans t
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1998'
  AND t.amount < (
    SELECT AVG(amount)
    FROM trans
    WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '1998'
  )

SELECT DISTINCT d.type
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
WHERE dist.A11 > 8000 
  AND dist.A11 <= 9000
  AND d.type != 'OWNER'

SELECT AVG(d.A15) 
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE d.A15 > 4000 
  AND a.date >= '1997-01-01'

SELECT t.trans_id
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.client_id
WHERE d.client_id = 3356
AND t.operation = 'VYBER'

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A11 > 10000

WITH male_clients AS (
    SELECT client_id FROM client WHERE gender = 'M'
),
male_accounts AS (
    SELECT d.account_id 
    FROM disp d 
    JOIN male_clients mc ON d.client_id = mc.client_id
),
loan_amounts AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y', l.date) as year,
        SUM(l.amount) as total_amount
    FROM loan l
    JOIN male_accounts ma ON l.account_id = ma.account_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', l.date) IN ('1996', '1997')
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y', l.date)
)
SELECT 
    ((MAX(CASE WHEN year = '1997' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) - 
      MAX(CASE WHEN year = '1996' THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / 
     MAX(CASE WHEN year = '1996' THEN total_amount ELSE 1 END)) AS growth_rate
FROM loan_amounts

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS statement_requests,
    k_symbol AS purpose_of_debit_3539
FROM trans 
WHERE account_id = 3 
    AND operation IN ('VKLAD', 'PREVOD Z UCTU')
GROUP BY k_symbol
HAVING SUM(amount) = 3539
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS statement_requests,
    k_symbol AS purpose_of_debit_3539
FROM trans 
WHERE account_id = 3 
    AND amount = 3539
    AND operation IN ('VKLAD', 'PREVOD Z UCTU')
GROUP BY k_symbol

SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'

SELECT a.account_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dist ON c.district_id = dist.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
ORDER BY dist.A11 ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(l.amount) 
FROM loan l
JOIN trans t ON l.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D') 
AND t.k_symbol = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'

SELECT 
    c.client_id,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) - 
    CASE WHEN strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id
WHERE ca.type = 'gold' 
AND d.type = 'OWNER'

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) / 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) AS ratio
FROM customers

SELECT ym.CustomerID
FROM yearmonth ym
JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212'
AND c.Segment = 'LAM'
ORDER BY ym.Consumption ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(monthly_consumption) AS average_monthly_consumption
FROM (
    SELECT ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) / 12 AS monthly_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Segment = 'SME' 
    AND ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID
) AS customer_avg
WHERE customer_avg.monthly_consumption IS NOT NULL

WITH czk_consumption AS (
    SELECT SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' 
    AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012'
),
eur_consumption AS (
    SELECT SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' 
    AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012'
)
SELECT (SELECT total_consumption FROM czk_consumption) - (SELECT total_consumption FROM eur_consumption) AS difference

SELECT SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) AS year
FROM yearmonth y
JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
GROUP BY SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4)
ORDER BY SUM(y.Consumption) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    SUBSTR(ym.Date, 5, 2) AS month
FROM yearmonth ym
JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'SME' 
    AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY SUM(ym.Consumption) DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH segment_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    c.Segment,
    AVG(ym.Consumption) as avg_consumption
  FROM yearmonth ym
  JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE ym.Date LIKE '2013%'
    AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
  GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT avg_consumption FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - 
  (SELECT avg_consumption FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM_diff,
  (SELECT avg_consumption FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - 
  (SELECT avg_consumption FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM_diff,
  (SELECT avg_consumption FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - 
  (SELECT avg_consumption FROM segment_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_SME_diff

WITH consumption_by_segment AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Segment,
        SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) AS Year,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' 
        AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
        AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4)
),
consumption_2012_2013 AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Year = '2012' THEN TotalConsumption ELSE 0 END) AS Consumption2012,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Year = '2013' THEN TotalConsumption ELSE 0 END) AS Consumption2013
    FROM consumption_by_segment
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT 
    Segment,
    CASE 
        WHEN Consumption2012 > 0 THEN ((Consumption2013 - Consumption2012) / Consumption2012) * 100
        ELSE 0 
    END AS PercentageIncrease
FROM consumption_2012_2013
ORDER BY Segment

       (strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', p."Birthday")) AS age
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p."ID" = l."ID"
WHERE l."GLU" >= 180 
  AND l."T-CHO" < 250

SELECT DISTINCT p."ID", 
       (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p."Birthday")) - 
       (strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', p."Birthday")) AS age,
       p."Diagnosis"
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p."ID" = l."ID"
WHERE l."RBC" < 3.5
ORDER BY p."ID"

SELECT p."ID", p."SEX"
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p."ID" = l."ID"
WHERE p."Diagnosis" = 'SLE' 
  AND l."HGB" > 10 
  AND l."HGB" < 17
ORDER BY p."Birthday" ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT p."ID", 
       (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p."Birthday")) - 
       (strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', p."Birthday")) AS age
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p."ID" = l."ID"
WHERE l."HCT" >= 52
  AND p."ID" IN (
    SELECT "ID"
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY "ID"
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
  )

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS platelet_difference
FROM Laboratory
WHERE PLT < 100 OR PLT > 400

SELECT DISTINCT p."ID"

WHERE strftime('%Y', l."Date") = '1984'

WITH older_patients AS (
    SELECT p."ID", p."SEX"
    FROM Patient p
    WHERE date(p."Birthday", '+55 years') < date('now')
),
abnormal_pt_patients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT l."ID"
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l."PT" >= 14
),
female_with_abnormal_pt AS (
    SELECT op."ID"
    FROM older_patients op
    INNER JOIN abnormal_pt_patients ap ON op."ID" = ap."ID"
    WHERE op."SEX" = 'F'
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT op."ID") = 0 THEN 0
        ELSE CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT fap."ID") AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT op."ID")
    END AS percentage
FROM older_patients op
LEFT JOIN female_with_abnormal_pt fap ON op."ID" = fap."ID"

WITH latest_ratings AS (
    SELECT 
        p.player_name,
        pa.overall_rating,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.player_name ORDER BY pa.id DESC) as rn
    FROM Player p
    JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
    WHERE p.player_name IN ('Ariel Borysiuk', 'Paulin Puel')
)
SELECT 
    ((MAX(CASE WHEN player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk' THEN overall_rating END) - 
      MAX(CASE WHEN player_name = 'Paulin Puel' THEN overall_rating END)) * 100.0 / 
     MAX(CASE WHEN player_name = 'Paulin Puel' THEN overall_rating END)) AS percentage_difference
FROM latest_ratings
WHERE rn = 1

      CAST(SUBSTR(r2.fastestLapSpeed, 1, LENGTH(r2.fastestLapSpeed) - 3) AS REAL)) * 100.0 / 
     CAST(SUBSTR(r2.fastestLapSpeed, 1, LENGTH(r2.fastestLapSpeed) - 3) AS REAL)) AS percentage_faster

WITH race_info AS (
    SELECT raceId 
    FROM races 
    WHERE year = 1988 
    AND circuitId = (
        SELECT circuitId 
        FROM circuits 
        WHERE circuitId = (
            SELECT circuitId 
            FROM races 
            WHERE year = 1988 
            LIMIT 1
        )
    )
),
finished_results AS (
    SELECT r.driverId, r.position, r.time, s.status
    FROM results r
    JOIN status s ON r.statusId = s.statusId
    WHERE r.raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM race_info)
    AND s.status LIKE 'Finished%'
    ORDER BY r.position
),
champion_time AS (
    SELECT time 
    FROM finished_results 
    WHERE position = 1
),
last_finisher_time AS (
    SELECT time 
    FROM finished_results 
    ORDER BY position DESC 
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    ((julianday((SELECT time FROM last_finisher_time)) - julianday((SELECT time FROM champion_time))) / 
     julianday((SELECT time FROM champion_time))) * 100 AS percentage_faster
FROM champion_time, last_finisher_time

),

SELECT AVG(oxygen_count) AS average_oxygen_atoms
FROM (
    SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS oxygen_count
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    WHERE a.element = 'o'
    AND m.molecule_id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT b.molecule_id
        FROM bond b
        WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
    )
    GROUP BY m.molecule_id
)
