SELECT a.element, COUNT(*) as tally
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
AND SUBSTR(a.atom_id, -2) = '_4'
GROUP BY a.element

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(a.element) AS ratio,
    m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR006'
GROUP BY m.label

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(a.atom_id) > 5

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.Virtual = 'F' AND ss.AvgScrMath > 400

SELECT CDSCode
FROM frpm
WHERE ("Enrollment (K-12)" + "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > 500

SELECT MAX(f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)") AS highest_eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm f
JOIN (
    SELECT s."cds", 
           CAST(s."NumGE1500" AS REAL) / s."NumTstTakr" AS excellence_rate
    FROM satscores s
    WHERE CAST(s."NumGE1500" AS REAL) / s."NumTstTakr" > 0.3
) sat ON f."CDSCode" = sat."cds"

SELECT 
    s."CharterNum",
    sc."AvgScrWrite",
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sc."AvgScrWrite" DESC) AS rank
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sc ON s."CDSCode" = sc."cds"
WHERE sc."AvgScrWrite" > 499
AND s."CharterNum" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sc."AvgScrWrite" DESC

SELECT 
    s."School",
    s."Street"
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f."CDSCode" = s."CDSCode"
WHERE (f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > 30

SELECT DISTINCT s."School"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s."CDSCode" = f."CDSCode"
JOIN satscores ss ON s."CDSCode" = ss."cds"
WHERE f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" > 0.1
AND ss."NumGE1500" > 0

SELECT 
    s."School",
    s."FundingType"
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s."CDSCode" = ss."cds"
WHERE s."District" LIKE 'Riverside%'
AND ss."AvgScrMath" > 400

SELECT 
    s."School",
    s."Street",
    s."City",
    s."State",
    s."Zip"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s."CDSCode" = f."CDSCode"
WHERE s."GSserved" = '9-12' 
    AND s."City" = 'Monterey'
    AND f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" > 800

SELECT 
    s."School",
    AVG(sc."AvgScrWrite") AS avg_writing_score,
    s."Phone" AS communication_number
FROM schools s
LEFT JOIN satscores sc ON s."CDSCode" = sc."cds"
WHERE s."OpenDate" > '1991-12-31' OR s."ClosedDate" < '2000-01-01'
GROUP BY s."School", s."Phone"

SELECT s."School", s."DOCType"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s."CDSCode" = f."CDSCode"
WHERE (f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > (
    SELECT AVG(f2."Enrollment (K-12)" - f2."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)")
    FROM schools s2
    JOIN frpm f2 ON s2."CDSCode" = f2."CDSCode"
    WHERE s2."FundingType" = 'Locally funded'
)
AND s."FundingType" = 'Locally funded'

SELECT 
    f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm f
JOIN (
    SELECT "CDSCode"
    FROM frpm
    ORDER BY "Enrollment (K-12)" DESC
    LIMIT 2 OFFSET 8
) AS top_schools ON f."CDSCode" = top_schools."CDSCode"
ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC

SELECT (f."FRPM Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)") AS eligible_free_meal_rate
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f."CDSCode" = s."CDSCode"
WHERE s."SOC" = '66'
ORDER BY f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE ss.NumTstTakr > 0
ORDER BY CAST(ss.NumGE1500 AS FLOAT) / ss.NumTstTakr ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    s."AdmFName1" || ' ' || s."AdmLName1" AS admin_full_name
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s."CDSCode" = ss."cds"
WHERE ss."NumGE1500" = (SELECT MAX("NumGE1500") FROM satscores)

SELECT AVG(s.NumTstTakr) 
FROM schools sc
JOIN satscores s ON sc.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE sc.OpenDate BETWEEN '1980-01-01' AND '1980-12-31'
AND sc.School LIKE '%Fresno%'

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE s.District = 'Fresno Unified'
ORDER BY ss.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT School
FROM (
    SELECT s.School,
           s.County,
           AVG(ss.AvgScrRead) as avg_reading_score,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.County ORDER BY AVG(ss.AvgScrRead) DESC) as rank_in_county
    FROM schools s
    JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
    WHERE s.Virtual = 'F'
    GROUP BY s.CDSCode, s.School, s.County
) ranked_schools
WHERE rank_in_county <= 5
ORDER BY County, avg_reading_score DESC

SELECT 
    s."School",
    ss."AvgScrWrite"
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s."CDSCode" = ss."cds"
WHERE s."AdmLName1" = 'Ulrich' OR s."AdmLName2" = 'Ulrich' OR s."AdmLName3" = 'Ulrich'

SELECT s."School", f."Enrollment (K-12)"
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f."CDSCode" = s."CDSCode"
WHERE s."DOC" = '31'
ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) / 12.0 AS monthly_average
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Alameda' 
AND DOC = '52' 
AND strftime('%Y', OpenDate) = '1980'

SELECT 
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN s.DOC = '54' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / 
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN s.DOC = '52' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) AS ratio
FROM schools s
WHERE s.District LIKE '%Orange County%'

WITH RankedScores AS (
    SELECT 
        sch."School",
        sch."Street",
        s."AvgScrMath",
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s."AvgScrMath" DESC) AS rank
    FROM satscores s
    JOIN schools sch ON s."cds" = sch."CDSCode"
)
SELECT 
    "Street" AS postal_street,
    "School" AS school_name
FROM RankedScores
WHERE rank = 7

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM frpm 
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode 
WHERE schools.County = 'Los Angeles' 
AND frpm."Charter School (Y/N)" = 0 
AND (frpm."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100 / frpm."Enrollment (K-12)") < 0.18

SELECT SUM(f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") AS total_enrollment
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f."CDSCode" = s."CDSCode"
WHERE s."EdOpsCode" = 'SSS' 
AND s."SOC" = '65'
AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'

SELECT 
    s."School",
    f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)"
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    frpm f ON s."CDSCode" = f."CDSCode"
WHERE 
    s."County" = 'Los Angeles' 
    AND s."GSserved" = 'K-9'
    AND f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)" IS NOT NULL

SELECT 
    s.County,
    COUNT(*) as num_schools
FROM schools s
WHERE s.Virtual = 'F' 
    AND s.County IN ('San Diego', 'Santa Barbara')
GROUP BY s.County
ORDER BY num_schools DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT "GSoffered"
FROM schools
WHERE "Longitude" = (
    SELECT MAX("Longitude")
    FROM schools
) OR "Longitude" = (
    SELECT MIN("Longitude")
    FROM schools
)

SELECT 
    s."City",
    COUNT(*) AS school_count
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s."CDSCode" = f."CDSCode"
WHERE s."GSoffered" = 'K-8' 
    AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Multiple Provision Types'
GROUP BY s."City"

SELECT f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)", f."District Code"
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f."CDSCode" = s."CDSCode"
WHERE s."AdmFName1" = 'Alusine'
   OR s."AdmFName2" = 'Alusine'
   OR s."AdmFName3" = 'Alusine'

SELECT 
    s."AdmEmail1",
    s."AdmEmail2"
FROM schools s
WHERE s."County" = 'San Bernardino'
    AND s."City" = 'San Bernardino'
    AND s."OpenDate" BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2010-12-31'
    AND s."SOC" = '62'
    AND s."DOC" = '54'

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' 
AND d.A3 = 'East Bohemia'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) 
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F' 
AND d.A11 > 6000 
AND d.A11 < 10000

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M' 
AND d.A3 = 'north Bohemia'
AND d.A11 > 8000

SELECT 
    (SELECT d.account_id 
     FROM client c 
     JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id 
     WHERE c.gender = 'F' 
     ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC 
     LIMIT 1) AS oldest_female_account,
    (SELECT MAX(A11) - MIN(A11) 
     FROM district) AS salary_gap

WITH youngest_client AS (
    SELECT c.client_id, c.birth_date, c.district_id
    FROM client c
    WHERE c.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client)
),
district_avg_salary AS (
    SELECT d.district_id, d.A11 as avg_salary
    FROM district d
),
client_with_salary AS (
    SELECT yc.client_id, yc.birth_date, yc.district_id, das.avg_salary
    FROM youngest_client yc
    JOIN district_avg_salary das ON yc.district_id = das.district_id
),
account_info AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.account_id as account_number, cws.district_id, cws.avg_salary
    FROM account a
    JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    JOIN client_with_salary cws ON d.client_id = cws.client_id
)
SELECT ai.account_number
FROM account_info ai
WHERE ai.avg_salary = (
    SELECT MAX(avg_salary)
    FROM account_info
)
LIMIT 1

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.date LIKE '1997%'
AND l.amount = (
    SELECT MIN(amount)
    FROM loan
    WHERE date LIKE '1997%'
)
AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12 
AND a.date LIKE '1993%'
ORDER BY l.amount DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp ON c.client_id = disp.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F' 
  AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
  AND d.A2 = 'Sokolov'

SELECT d.A2
FROM client c
JOIN disp dis ON c.client_id = dis.client_id
JOIN account a ON dis.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F' 
  AND c.birth_date = '1976-01-29'

WITH south_bohemia_branch AS (
    SELECT district_id, A4 as inhabitants
    FROM district
    WHERE A3 = 'south Bohemia'
    ORDER BY CAST(A4 AS INTEGER) DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
male_clients_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) as male_count
    FROM client c
    JOIN south_bohemia_branch s ON c.district_id = s.district_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'M'
),
total_clients_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count
    FROM client c
    JOIN south_bohemia_branch s ON c.district_id = s.district_id
)
SELECT (CAST(mc.male_count AS FLOAT) / CAST(tc.total_count AS FLOAT)) * 100 AS percentage_male_clients
FROM male_clients_count mc, total_clients_count tc

WITH first_loan_client AS (
    SELECT l.account_id
    FROM loan l
    WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05'
    LIMIT 1
),
client_account AS (
    SELECT d.client_id
    FROM disp d
    JOIN first_loan_client flc ON d.account_id = flc.account_id
    LIMIT 1
),
balance_data AS (
    SELECT 
        t.account_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN t.date = '1993-03-22' THEN t.balance END) as initial_balance,
        MAX(CASE WHEN t.date = '1998-12-27' THEN t.balance END) as final_balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN first_loan_client flc ON t.account_id = flc.account_id
    WHERE t.date IN ('1993-03-22', '1998-12-27')
    GROUP BY t.account_id
)
SELECT 
    ((final_balance - initial_balance) * 100.0 / initial_balance) as increase_rate
FROM balance_data
WHERE initial_balance IS NOT NULL AND final_balance IS NOT NULL

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'A' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / SUM(l.amount) AS percentage
FROM loan l

SELECT 
    (COUNT(CASE WHEN l.status = 'C' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)) AS percentage_running
FROM loan l
WHERE l.amount < 100000

SELECT 
    ((d.A13 - d.A12) / d.A12) * 100 AS unemployment_increment_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D'

SELECT 
    d.A2 AS district,
    COUNT(c.client_id) AS female_clients
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY COUNT(c.client_id) DESC
LIMIT 9

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.amount >= 250000
AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
AND l.date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1997-12-31'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.account_id)
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.district_id = 1 AND l.status = 'C'

WITH ranked_districts AS (
    SELECT district_id, A15,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A15 DESC) as crime_rank
    FROM district
)
SELECT COUNT(*) as male_client_count
FROM client c
JOIN ranked_districts rd ON c.district_id = rd.district_id
WHERE rd.crime_rank = 2 AND c.gender = 'M'

SELECT d.A2
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ' 
  AND t.operation = 'VYBER'
  AND t.date LIKE '1996-01%'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT DISTINCT t.account_id
FROM trans t
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU'
  AND strftime('%Y', t.date) = '1998'
  AND t.amount < (
    SELECT AVG(amount)
    FROM trans
    WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '1998'
  )

SELECT DISTINCT d.type
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dist ON a.district_id = dist.district_id
WHERE dist.A11 > 8000 
  AND dist.A11 <= 9000
  AND d.type != 'OWNER'

SELECT AVG(d.A15) 
FROM district d
WHERE d.A15 > 4000
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 
    FROM account a 
    WHERE a.district_id = d.district_id 
    AND a.date >= '1997-01-01'
)

SELECT t.trans_id
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.client_id = 3356 AND d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.operation = 'VYBER'

SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'F' THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A11 > 10000

WITH male_clients AS (
    SELECT client_id 
    FROM client 
    WHERE gender = 'M'
),
male_accounts AS (
    SELECT d.account_id 
    FROM disp d 
    JOIN male_clients mc ON d.client_id = mc.client_id
),
loan_amounts AS (
    SELECT 
        strftime('%Y', l.date) as year,
        SUM(l.amount) as total_amount
    FROM loan l
    JOIN male_accounts ma ON l.account_id = ma.account_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', l.date) IN ('1996', '1997')
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y', l.date)
)
SELECT 
    ((MAX(CASE WHEN year = '1997' THEN total_amount END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = '1996' THEN total_amount END)) * 100.0 / 
     MAX(CASE WHEN year = '1996' THEN total_amount END)) as growth_rate
FROM loan_amounts

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) as frequency,
    k_symbol as purpose
FROM trans 
WHERE account_id = 3 
AND amount = 3539
GROUP BY k_symbol

SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'

SELECT a.account_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dist ON c.district_id = dist.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
ORDER BY dist.A11 ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(l.amount) 
FROM loan l
INNER JOIN trans t ON l.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D') 
AND t.k_symbol = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'

SELECT 
    c.client_id,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) - 
    CASE WHEN strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id
WHERE ca.type = 'gold' 
AND d.type = 'OWNER'

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) / 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) AS ratio
FROM customers

SELECT ym.CustomerID
FROM yearmonth ym
JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212'
  AND c.Segment = 'LAM'
ORDER BY ym.Consumption ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(monthly_consumption) AS average_monthly_consumption
FROM (
    SELECT ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) / 12 AS monthly_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Segment = 'SME' 
    AND ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID
) AS customer_avg
WHERE monthly_consumption IS NOT NULL

WITH czk_consumption AS (
    SELECT SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_czk
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012'
    AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
),
eur_consumption AS (
    SELECT SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_eur
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012'
    AND c.Currency = 'EUR'
)
SELECT (SELECT total_czk FROM czk_consumption) - (SELECT total_eur FROM eur_consumption) AS difference

SELECT SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) AS year
FROM yearmonth ym
JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
GROUP BY SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4)
ORDER BY SUM(ym.Consumption) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT SUBSTR(y.Date, 5, 2) AS month
FROM yearmonth y
JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'SME'
AND y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY SUM(y.Consumption) DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH customer_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.CustomerID,
        c.Segment,
        SUM(ym.Consumption) as total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
lowest_consumption_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        Segment,
        total_consumption,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Segment ORDER BY total_consumption ASC) as rn
    FROM customer_consumption
),
segment_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        AVG(total_consumption) as avg_consumption
    FROM lowest_consumption_customers
    WHERE rn = 1
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') - 
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_LAM_diff,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - 
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_KAM_diff,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - 
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM segment_averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_SME_diff

WITH consumption_by_segment AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Segment,
        SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) as Year,
        SUM(y.Consumption) as TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' 
        AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
        AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4)
),
consumption_comparison AS (
    SELECT 
        Segment,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Year = '2012' THEN TotalConsumption ELSE 0 END) as Consumption2012,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Year = '2013' THEN TotalConsumption ELSE 0 END) as Consumption2013
    FROM consumption_by_segment
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT 
    Segment,
    CASE 
        WHEN Consumption2012 > 0 THEN ((Consumption2013 - Consumption2012) / Consumption2012) * 100
        ELSE 0 
    END as PercentageIncrease
FROM consumption_comparison
ORDER BY Segment

SELECT SUM(Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
FROM yearmonth
WHERE CustomerID = 6
  AND Date >= '201308'
  AND Date <= '201311'

SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gasstations WHERE Country = 'CZE' AND Segment = 'Value for money') -
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gasstations WHERE Country = 'SVK' AND Segment = 'Value for money') AS discount_stations_difference

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM customers c
WHERE c.Segment = 'SME'

WITH lam_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.CustomerID
    FROM customers c
    WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM'
),
lam_consumption AS (
    SELECT yc.CustomerID
    FROM yearmonth yc
    JOIN lam_customers lc ON yc.CustomerID = lc.CustomerID
    WHERE yc.Consumption > 46.73
    GROUP BY yc.CustomerID
)
SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT lc.CustomerID) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.CustomerID) AS percentage
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN lam_consumption lc ON c.CustomerID = lc.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM'

SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN Consumption > 528.3 THEN 1 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM yearmonth
WHERE Date = '201202'

SELECT MAX(Consumption) AS highest_monthly_consumption
FROM yearmonth
WHERE SUBSTR(Date, 1, 4) = '2012'

SELECT DISTINCT p.Description
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
WHERE t.Date LIKE '2012-08-%'

SELECT DISTINCT gs.Country
FROM gasstations gs
JOIN transactions_1k t ON gs.GasStationID = t.GasStationID
WHERE t.Date LIKE '2012-08-%'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ym.CustomerID) 
FROM yearmonth ym

),
consumption_data AS (
    SELECT 
        y."CustomerID",
        SUM(CASE WHEN y."Date" LIKE '2012%' THEN y."Consumption" ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN y."Date" LIKE '2013%' THEN y."Consumption" ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customer_payment cp ON y."CustomerID" = cp."CustomerID"
    GROUP BY y."CustomerID"
)

            FROM Player_Attributes pa 
            JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
            WHERE p.height IN ((SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player), (SELECT MIN(height) FROM Player))

    END

WITH race_info AS (
    SELECT r.raceId
    FROM races r
    JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
    WHERE r.year = 1988 
    AND c.circuitId = (
        SELECT circuitId 
        FROM circuits 
        WHERE circuitId IN (
            SELECT DISTINCT circuitId 
            FROM races 
            WHERE year = 1988
        )
        LIMIT 1
    )
),
champion_time AS (
    SELECT r.time
    FROM results r
    WHERE r.raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM race_info)
    AND r.position = 1
),
last_finisher_time AS (
    SELECT r.time
    FROM results r
    JOIN status s ON r.statusId = s.statusId
    WHERE r.raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM race_info)
    AND s.status LIKE 'Finished%'
    AND r.position = (
        SELECT MAX(position)
        FROM results r2
        JOIN status s2 ON r2.statusId = s2.statusId
        WHERE r2.raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM race_info)
        AND s2.status LIKE 'Finished%'
    )
)

WITH MostInfluentialUser AS (
    SELECT Id
    FROM users
    ORDER BY Reputation DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
PostsByMostInfluentialUser AS (
    SELECT p.Id, p.Score
    FROM posts p
    JOIN MostInfluentialUser m ON p.OwnerUserId = m.Id
),
HighScorePosts AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) as high_score_count
    FROM PostsByMostInfluentialUser
    WHERE Score > 50
),
TotalPosts AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count
    FROM PostsByMostInfluentialUser
)
SELECT 
    CAST(h.high_score_count AS FLOAT) * 100 / t.total_count AS percentage
FROM HighScorePosts h, TotalPosts t

SELECT AVG(oxygen_count) AS average_oxygen_atoms
FROM (
    SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS oxygen_count
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    WHERE a.element = 'o'
    AND m.molecule_id IN (
        SELECT DISTINCT b.molecule_id
        FROM bond b
        WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
    )
    GROUP BY m.molecule_id
) AS molecule_oxygen_counts

WITH segment_consumption AS (

),
segment_averages AS (
    SELECT 
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN avg_consumption END) AS sme_avg,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN avg_consumption END) AS lam_avg,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN avg_consumption END) AS kam_avg
    FROM segment_consumption
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT sme_avg FROM segment_averages) - (SELECT lam_avg FROM segment_averages) AS sme_lam_diff,
    (SELECT lam_avg FROM segment_averages) - (SELECT kam_avg FROM segment_averages) AS lam_kam_diff,
    (SELECT kam_avg FROM segment_averages) - (SELECT sme_avg FROM segment_averages) AS kam_sme_diff

WITH consumption_by_segment AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Segment,
        SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) as Year,
        SUM(ym.Consumption) as TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR' 
        AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
        AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4)
),
consumption_2012 AS (
    SELECT Segment, TotalConsumption as Consumption2012
    FROM consumption_by_segment
    WHERE Year = '2012'
),
consumption_2013 AS (
    SELECT Segment, TotalConsumption as Consumption2013
    FROM consumption_by_segment
    WHERE Year = '2013'
)
SELECT 
    c2012.Segment,
    CASE 
        WHEN c2012.Consumption2012 = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ((c2013.Consumption2013 - c2012.Consumption2012) / c2012.Consumption2012) * 100
    END as PercentageIncrease
FROM consumption_2012 c2012
JOIN consumption_2013 c2013 ON c2012.Segment = c2013.Segment
ORDER BY c2012.Segment

    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE Date = '2012-08-25' AND Price = 634.8
),
customer_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        CustomerID,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '2012%' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '2013%' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM yearmonth
    WHERE CustomerID IN (SELECT CustomerID FROM customer_transaction)
    GROUP BY CustomerID
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN consumption_2012 > 0 THEN (consumption_2012 - consumption_2013) / consumption_2012
        ELSE NULL

FROM customer_consumption

WITH race_data AS (
    SELECT r.raceId, r.name, r.year
    FROM races r
    WHERE r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND r.year = 1988
),
champion_data AS (
    SELECT res.driverId, res.time, res.milliseconds
    FROM results res
    JOIN race_data rd ON res.raceId = rd.raceId
    WHERE res.position = 1 AND res.statusId IN (SELECT statusId FROM status WHERE status LIKE 'Finished%')
),
last_driver_data AS (
    SELECT res.driverId, res.time, res.milliseconds
    FROM results res
    JOIN race_data rd ON res.raceId = rd.raceId
    WHERE res.statusId IN (SELECT statusId FROM status WHERE status LIKE 'Finished%')
    ORDER BY res.milliseconds DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    CAST((CAST((ld.milliseconds - cd.milliseconds) AS REAL) / CAST(cd.milliseconds AS REAL)) * 100 AS REAL) AS percentage_faster
FROM champion_data cd
CROSS JOIN last_driver_data ld

    AVG(CAST(SUBSTR(res.time, 1, INSTR(res.time, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 3600 + 
        CAST(SUBSTR(res.time, INSTR(res.time, ':') + 1, INSTR(res.time, ':', INSTR(res.time, ':') + 1) - INSTR(res.time, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60 + 
        CAST(SUBSTR(res.time, INSTR(res.time, ':', INSTR(res.time, ':') + 1) + 1, INSTR(res.time, '.') - INSTR(res.time, ':', INSTR(res.time, ':') + 1) - 1) AS REAL)) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM races r
JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE r.year < 1975 
    AND res.position = 1 
    AND res.time IS NOT NULL 
    AND res.time LIKE '%:%.%'
GROUP BY r.year
ORDER BY r.year

),

WITH banned_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        l.format,
        COUNT(*) as banned_count
    FROM legalities l
    WHERE l.status = 'Banned'
    GROUP BY l.format
),
max_banned AS (
    SELECT MAX(banned_count) as max_count
    FROM banned_counts
)
SELECT 
    bc.format,
    c.name
FROM banned_counts bc
JOIN max_banned mb ON bc.banned_count = mb.max_count
JOIN legalities l ON bc.format = l.format
JOIN cards c ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE l.status = 'Banned'
ORDER BY bc.format, c.name

SELECT AVG(oxygen_count) AS average_oxygen_atoms
FROM (
    SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(a.atom_id) AS oxygen_count
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
    JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    WHERE b.bond_type = '-'
    AND a.element = 'o'
    GROUP BY m.molecule_id
) AS molecule_oxygen_counts

SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS FLOAT) / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) FROM molecule WHERE label = '+') AS average_single_bonds
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND b.bond_type = '-'

WITH molecules_with_double_bonds AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT b.molecule_id
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.bond_type = '='
),
carbon_atoms_in_double_bond_molecules AS (
    SELECT a.atom_id
    FROM atom a
    INNER JOIN molecules_with_double_bonds m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    WHERE a.element = 'c'
),
total_atoms_in_double_bond_molecules AS (
    SELECT a.atom_id
    FROM atom a
    INNER JOIN molecules_with_double_bonds m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
)
SELECT 
    CAST(COUNT(c.atom_id) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(t.atom_id) AS percentage
FROM total_atoms_in_double_bond_molecules t
LEFT JOIN carbon_atoms_in_double_bond_molecules c ON t.atom_id = c.atom_id

    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.element = 's' THEN a.atom_id END) AS sulfur_atoms

WITH carcinogenic_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
    FROM molecule m
    WHERE m.label = '+'
),
molecules_with_fluorine AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.molecule_id
    FROM atom a
    INNER JOIN carcinogenic_molecules cm ON a.molecule_id = cm.molecule_id
    WHERE a.element = 'f'
),
carcinogenic_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) as total_carcinogenic
    FROM carcinogenic_molecules
),
fluorine_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) as has_fluorine
    FROM molecules_with_fluorine
)
SELECT 
    CAST((total_carcinogenic - has_fluorine) AS FLOAT) * 100 / total_carcinogenic AS percentage
FROM carcinogenic_count, fluorine_count

WHERE ("Enrollment (K-12)" + "Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > 500

SELECT MAX(f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)") AS highest_eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE (CAST(s.NumGE1500 AS FLOAT) / CAST(s.NumTstTakr AS FLOAT)) > 0.3

SELECT 
    s."CharterNum",
    AVG(ss."AvgScrWrite") AS average_writing_score,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(ss."AvgScrWrite") DESC) AS rank
FROM 
    "schools" s
JOIN 
    "satscores" ss ON s."CDSCode" = ss."cds"
WHERE 
    ss."AvgScrWrite" > 499
    AND s."CharterNum" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
    s."CharterNum"
ORDER BY 
    average_writing_score DESC

SELECT s."School", s."Street"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s."CDSCode" = f."CDSCode"

FROM frpm f

WHERE f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" > 0.1
AND sa."NumGE1500" >= 1500

SELECT DISTINCT s."School Name", f."Charter Funding Type"
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f."CDSCode" = s."CDSCode"
WHERE s."District Name" LIKE 'Riverside%'
AND f."CDSCode" IN (
    SELECT "cds"
    FROM satscores
    WHERE "AvgScrMath" > 400
)
AND s."CDSCode" IN (
    SELECT "cds"
    FROM satscores
    GROUP BY "cds"
    HAVING AVG("AvgScrMath") > 400
)

SELECT 
    s."School",
    s."Street",
    s."City",
    s."State",
    s."Zip"
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s."CDSCode" = f."CDSCode"
WHERE s."County" = 'Monterey'
AND s."SOCType" = 'High Schools (Public)'
AND f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 800
AND f."Academic Year" = (SELECT MAX("Academic Year") FROM frpm)
AND s."StatusType" = 'Active'

SELECT 
    s.School,
    AVG(sc.AvgScrWrite) AS avg_writing_score,
    s.Phone AS communication_number
FROM schools s
LEFT JOIN satscores sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds
WHERE s.OpenDate > '1991-12-31' OR s.ClosedDate < '2000-01-01'
GROUP BY s.School, s.Phone

SELECT s."School", s."DOCType"
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f."CDSCode" = s."CDSCode"
WHERE f."Charter Funding Type" = 'Locally funded'
  AND (f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > (
    SELECT AVG(f2."Enrollment (K-12)" - f2."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)")
    FROM frpm f2
    JOIN schools s2 ON f2."CDSCode" = s2."CDSCode"
    WHERE f2."Charter Funding Type" = 'Locally funded'
  )

WITH first_loan_client AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id
    FROM loan l
    JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
    WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05'
    LIMIT 1
),
balances AS (
    SELECT 
        (SELECT balance FROM trans t1 
         JOIN first_loan_client flc ON t1.account_id IN (
             SELECT account_id FROM disp WHERE client_id = flc.client_id
         )
         WHERE t1.date = '1993-03-22' 
         ORDER BY t1.trans_id 
         LIMIT 1) AS balance_start,
        (SELECT balance FROM trans t2 
         JOIN first_loan_client flc ON t2.account_id IN (
             SELECT account_id FROM disp WHERE client_id = flc.client_id
         )
         WHERE t2.date = '1998-12-27' 
         ORDER BY t2.trans_id DESC 
         LIMIT 1) AS balance_end
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN balance_start IS NOT NULL AND balance_end IS NOT NULL AND balance_start != 0
        THEN ((balance_end - balance_start) * 100.0 / balance_start)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS increase_rate
FROM balances

WITH male_clients AS (
    SELECT client_id FROM client WHERE gender = 'M'
),
male_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id 
    FROM account a
    JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
    JOIN male_clients mc ON d.client_id = mc.client_id
),
loans_1996 AS (
    SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_amount
    FROM loan l
    JOIN male_accounts ma ON l.account_id = ma.account_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1996'
),
loans_1997 AS (
    SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_amount
    FROM loan l
    JOIN male_accounts ma ON l.account_id = ma.account_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997'
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN l1996.total_amount IS NOT NULL AND l1997.total_amount IS NOT NULL AND l1996.total_amount != 0
        THEN ((l1997.total_amount - l1996.total_amount) * 100.0 / l1996.total_amount)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS growth_rate
FROM loans_1996 l1996
CROSS JOIN loans_1997 l1997
